name: Tim Worthington
caption: A two-time former MWA World Heavyweight Champion who returned to the ring for UKWA's own Champions League after the birth of his son.

tenures.source: Billed as a two-time former MWA World Heavyweight Champion making his UKWA in-ring return in the Champions League on the 5 April 2004 UpRising broadcast, where he lost to Cicatriz.

name: Cicatriz
caption: A UKWA Champions League wrestler who won her opening-round match after a disqualification ruling against her was overturned by a contract clause.

tenures.source: Defeated Tim Worthington by pinfall (the Faisca) in the Champions League on the 5 April 2004 UpRising broadcast, after an initial disqualification against her was overturned under a clause in her own contract.

name: Angelus Dellanuite
caption: A UKWA Champions League wrestler who won his opening-round match by pinfall and is set for a grudge match the following week.

tenures.source: Defeated Synskin by pinfall (a spinning kick) in the Champions League on the 5 April 2004 UpRising broadcast; billed for a further match against Koahaka the following week.

name: Elysa Stone
caption: The on-screen manager of UKWA Champions League wrestlers Angelus Dellanuite and Cicatriz.

tenures.source: Billed as Angelus Dellanuite and Cicatriz's manager on the 5 April 2004 UpRising broadcast.

name: Synskin
caption: A UKWA Champions League wrestler who lost to Angelus Dellanuite by pinfall after a late kick.

tenures.source: Lost to Angelus Dellanuite by pinfall on the 5 April 2004 UpRising broadcast; billed for a further match against Ed Sharples the following week.

name: Mark Severed
caption: The on-screen manager of UKWA Champions League wrestler Synskin.

tenures.source: Billed as Synskin's manager on the 5 April 2004 UpRising broadcast.

name: Veronique
caption: A UKWA Champions League wrestler pulled from the tournament after an in-story backstage attack.

tenures.source: Withdrawn from her scheduled Champions League match against Ed Sharples on the 5 April 2004 UpRising broadcast after an in-story attack by Koahaka, who took her place; the promotion rules her out of the tournament entirely rather than rescheduling her.

name: "The Man" Ed Sharples
caption: A UKWA Champions League wrestler who lost his opening-round match to a late replacement opponent.

tenures.source: Lost to Koahaka in the Champions League on the 5 April 2004 UpRising broadcast, after Koahaka was substituted in as a late replacement for the original opponent; billed for a further match against Synskin the following week.

name: Koahaka
caption: A UKWA wrestler added to the Champions League as a late replacement after attacking another competitor backstage.

tenures.source: Defeated "The Man" Ed Sharples in the Champions League on the 5 April 2004 UpRising broadcast, entering the match as a late replacement after attacking Veronique backstage; billed for a further match against Angelus Dellanuite the following week.

name: Steve Pinex
caption: A UKWA Champions League wrestler who lost the broadcast's main event by pinfall.

tenures.source: Lost to Protean by pinfall in the Champions League main event on the 5 April 2004 UpRising broadcast.

name: "The Major" Richard Kendall
caption: UKWA's own on-screen President, who oversees the promotion's Champions League tournament and, by the time of the promotion's 2005 relaunch bid, is rumoured to hold influence with a rival promotion.

tenures.source: Opens the 5 April 2004 UpRising broadcast as UKWA's own President; a January 2005 press release names him again, by then said to hold a position of power at the rival Millennium Wrestling Alliance that might let him restart UKWA himself.

name: Joe Kame'eleihiwa
caption: A UKWA wrestler who won his debut match by submission and later joined Koahaka in confronting Angelus Dellanuite.

tenures.source: Won a debut match by submission (the Ho'eha O Make Loa) on the 5 April 2004 UpRising broadcast, replacing an unnamed originally-scheduled wrestler; later confronts Angelus Dellanuite alongside Koahaka in a post-match angle.
